seedKeywords.title: Seed keywords
seedKeywords.description: Starting terms to expand, e.g. ["laptop", "sepatu pria"]. Each seed is run through Blibli's live autocomplete and, with expansion on, through a suffix sweep that pulls far more of the suggestion index.

expansionMode.title: Expansion mode
expansionMode.description: How hard to mine each seed. A bare seed returns only a handful of suggestions (measured: 6 for 'laptop'); appending letters pulls a different slice each time (measured: 67 unique keywords from a-j alone). 'related' adds Blibli's 'refine your search' terms. 'full' does both plus digits.
enumTitles: None - seed only (1 request per seed)
Alphabet - seed + a-z (27 requests per seed)
Related - seed + refine-search terms (2 per seed)
Full - alphabet + digits + related (38 per seed)

includeCompetition.title: Measure competition per keyword
includeCompetition.description: For every keyword, count how many products Blibli actually returns for it - the number that tells you how hard the keyword is to rank for. Costs one extra request per keyword. See the README: Blibli publishes no search volume, and this is the measured figure offered in its place.

includeTrending.title: Include trending searches
includeTrending.description: Add Blibli's marketplace-wide trending search terms as extra rows. Works with no seed keywords at all.

includeCurated.title: Include curated promo keywords
includeCurated.description: Add the editorially curated keywords Blibli promotes in its search box, each with the promo page it links to.

minWordCount.title: Minimum word count
minWordCount.description: Keep only keywords with at least this many words. Set to 3 to harvest long-tail terms only - easier to rank for and usually higher-converting. 0 disables.

maxKeywordsPerSeed.title: Max keywords per seed
maxKeywordsPerSeed.description: Stop after this many keywords per seed. 0 means no limit - harvest whatever the expansion plan yields.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel competition lookups. Keep low to stay under Blibli's rate limiting.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Blibli is behind Cloudflare and throttles sustained traffic from one IP. Apify Residential proxy with country 'ID' is recommended, especially with expansion and competition measurement on.
